reasoning: The printed axes are linear and correctly calibrated: x runs from 0 to 1200 mbar and y from 0 to 5 mmol/g, with the frame extending slightly beyond the outer ticks. The main extraction problem is coverage and same-color series assignment in the crowded low-pressure fan and lower N2 region. CO2 273K is almost entirely missed, while CO2 283K, 293K, 323K, 333K, and CO2 373K have substantial shortfalls or cross-assignment. The legend glyph measurements for CO2 343K, 353K, 363K, and 373K are raster misclassifications caused by small symbols and antialiasing; the source legend visibly shows a pentagon, diamond, star, and circle respectively, so the declared structures are retained.

x.reason: The source x-axis labels are 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, and 1200 mbar. The re-plotted data span the same horizontal values against these ticks; the tiny negative minimum is an edge/marker-centre tolerance effect, not a shifted axis.

y.reason: The source y-axis labels run from 0 to 5 mmol/g. The re-plotted curves occupy the same values relative to the ticks, with the maximum just below 5 as in the source.

issues: CO2 273K has only 2 of about 36 markers detected.
CO2 283K and CO2 293K have substantial marker shortfalls and are confused with nearby same-color N2 or CO2 curves.
CO2 323K is overfilled by false/template-assigned points; its expected count is about 36, not 55.
CO2 333K and CO2 373K are strongly confused because their colors are close; CO2 373K has very poor recall and many points are assigned to CO2 333K.
The low-pressure fan from approximately 0 to 100 mbar is dense and overlapping and needs explicit curve bands and additional passes.

notes: The source contains 11 CO2 and 6 N2 adsorption series. The N2 series remain in the structure for color/shape disambiguation but are excluded from extraction. Legend color values are retained from the declared source palette where raster glyph sampling is visibly darkened or shape-confused.
